body:
Thanks, I've added the forgotten-idea scenario to my feedback notes. I haven't verified that weeks-later, vague-question case yet.

The short first-run explanation is a useful suggestion. I'd keep local processing, cloud AI and sync separate: local inference processes the content on the phone; cloud AI sends the selected input for processing; encrypted sync is a separate option. Saying it stays on the phone unless sync is enabled would miss the cloud-AI path.

For that forgotten idea, would a few likely notes with quoted snippets be useful, or would you expect one direct answer?
